subject: Stately pilot wrap + quick ask: 3-line quote?
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@statelyhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Stately pilot wrap + quick ask: 3-line quote?

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for running the two-week pilot with us. Attached is a concise summary (stately_pilot_summary.pdf) but highlights below: 

- Average inference latency down 34% (from 420ms -> 280ms) for the core triage model under production-like load
- Per-request cost decreased ~27% after auto-batching and prefix cache config adjustments
- End-to-end throughput improved 2.3x during peak windows with no error-rate increase (error rate stayed <0.3%)
- Observed user satisfaction (post-interaction surveys) +8 net points in targeted flows

We’re putting together a short case snippet and a 30–60s customer quote to publish on our site and in sales collateral. Would Stately be open to: 

1) A short, 10–15 minute call to capture a 1–2 sentence quote and agree on attribution?
2) Permission to publish one short sentence (we’ll share copy before publishing)?

If yes, I can send two proposed times tomorrow and a couple of draft quote options to make this quick.

Attachments: stately_pilot_summary.pdf (report), kpi_export.csv (raw metrics)

Thanks,
Sofia
